about: part09 A: quests that could not be completed or started

entries.why: Legend of the Lake (15) step 2 needs 2 of Wizard Lost/Barbaric Tales/Lisreen's Plight/Forged Excellence, but those 7 rows required a FINISHED 'Legend of the Lake' (DataQuest.cs CheckQuestQualification), so nobody could ever finish part 15 and the whole Armsman/Scout/Friar/Theurgist epic was dead; the period has Nimue hand them out during part I (Allakhazam 142: 'She will then give you a quest called Wizard Lost')
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 142 Legend of the Lake (level 15): nested sub-quests given during Part I (patch 1.53 note: two of four)

Legend of the Lake (level 15) had MaxLevel 19, so a player who reached 20 first lost the whole epic line (parts 20/25, Hands of Fate, Feast, Craft of Retribution); the period page for part 15 gives no maximum level (the spec's 19 was inferred) and parts 20/25 are Max 50
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 142 head: no Min/Max level; quests 185/186 (parts 20, 25) Max Level 50

entries.why: Wisdom was MinLevel 11 = MaxLevel 11: a Wizard/Sorcerer/Minstrel who passed level 11 without it lost Scura Tragedia, La Morti Parla, Animare il morti, Legione Perso and the Academy epic for good; the walkthrough says the trainers gave it 'upon reaching lvl 11' (an epic step, offered from then on), and every later part of the line is Max 50
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 53 Wisdom ('Given by the trainers upon reaching lvl 11'); quest 94 Scura Tragedia Max Level 50

entries.why: AllowedClasses held 14 (the level 1-5 Fighter base class) on a level 32 quest, so Armsmen, Mercenaries and Paladins could never take it; the period 'Fighter' label means the Albion fighter classes (Armsman 2, Mercenary 11, Paladin 1); Scout 3, Cleric 6, Infiltrator 9 kept
entries.source: Allakhazam quest 161 Wizard's Demand: 'Class: Fighter Scout Cleric Infiltrator'
